mechanism: Growth in industrial robotics and embodied AI can increase demand for NVIDIA simulation, world models, training compute, edge modules, safety tooling and the CUDA developer stack; integrations across major robot makers and humanoid developers establish a product channel, although attributable revenue and deployment economics remain undisclosed.
catalyst: Robot makers disclose repeat paid NVIDIA-based deployments, attributable system or software revenue becomes material, safety certification supports scale, or multi-site autonomous-machine deployments show durable uptime and task economics.
invalidation: Humanoids remain demonstrations; fixed automation wins the same tasks; robot makers internalize or select competing compute and software; safety or reliability blocks scale; or physical-AI revenue remains immaterial despite ecosystem announcements.
